items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: having seen you since you had worked together on his recording, “Reflections”

ctx.x: Talking with Steve Lacey about you, I asked him about having seen you since you had worked together on his recording, “Reflections”. And he said, “Oh I remember when he (Elvin) first came to New York because he was a friend of Cecil Taylor’s, every time Cecil Taylor would get on the band stand all the musicians would leave but Elvin would get on the band stand because he wanted to play with him”. Is that an accurate recollection of his?
Yeah that’s accurate. Cecil used to tell that story too. He’s going to play with me next week over at Blue Note.
